system.description:
You gain a trained animal companion. It anticipates and obeys your commands, and is a Cohort (Expert: Hunter). It has +1 effect against the supernatural. If it dies, you may spend a downtime action to train another companion. Choose one of the following, and you may take this ability again to choose another:

    • Our Minds As One - you and your companion may share thoughts and senses telepathically

    • Swift As Arrow’s Flight - your animal companion moves faster than any ordinary creature; it can only be outpaced by supernatural force

    • As Starlight - your animal companion can become intangible, and gains +1d when attempting to remain undetected
